parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The file name in the format of `<file name>.<extension>`.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The edge instance ID. You can obtain the ID by hovering over the target edge instance name on the **Edge Instances** page in the [IoT Platform console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list).

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) operation to obtain the ID.

> This parameter is required when **Type** is set to **INSTANCE_DRIVER_VERSION_CONFIG**.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description:
The resource ID. Currently, only driver resources are supported. Set this parameter to the driver ID.

You can obtain the driver ID by hovering over the target driver name on the **Driver Management** page in the [IoT Platform console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list). You can also call the [QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~) operation to obtain the driver ID.

parameters.name: ResourceVersion
parameters.description: The resource version. Currently, only driver resources are supported. Set this parameter to the driver version.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The file content type. Valid values:

- DRIVER_VERSION_CONTENT: the code of a driver version.
- DRIVER_VERSION_DEFAULT_CONFIG: the default configurations of a driver version.
- INSTANCE_DRIVER_VERSION_CONFIG: the configuration of a driver version for an edge instance.
